finding: The cp64 durable job discarded the Qwen client's bounded upstreamStatus or causeCode details, so historical evidence cannot distinguish an HTTP rejection from a transport failure. Service health and Tailnet peer presence rule out a broad OpenReel process outage but do not prove endpoint request success.

localRemediation.behavior: Commercial jobs now retain only a bounded Qwen diagnostic: provider identity, http or transport category, an integer HTTP status when present, and an allow-pattern transport cause code when present.
localRemediation.privacy: Raw messages, response bodies, URLs, tokens, credentials and arbitrary cause strings are not persisted.

nextBoundary: Deploying the local diagnostic patch and executing any provider-backed successor remain separate actions. A paid successor requires new explicit one-action authority and must retain the existing CNY limit and zero-blind-retry controls.
